description: This file defines the ListViewFacade class, which acts as a facade for managing and displaying list views in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It handles loading metadata, configuring list views, and rendering either ListView or ListViewSmarty components.

classes.name: ListViewFacade
classes.description: A facade class that simplifies interaction with ListView and ListViewSmarty components for rendering list views in the application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewFacade with focus, module, and type, then builds the list view component.

methods.name: getDisplayColumns
methods.description: Static method to retrieve display columns configuration for a given module, loading metadata files as necessary.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Determines whether to use ListView.html or ListViewSmarty and initializes the appropriate object.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the list view with template, filtering, sorting, and other parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered list view, either directly or as a returned string.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the list view display.
